cases.description: Build production APIs with C# and ASP.NET Core. SQL and Entity Framework Core are required. Kubernetes is used by the infrastructure team and is not required for this role.
cases.rationale: The candidate explicitly lists every required backend technology. Kubernetes is contextual and explicitly not required.

cases.description: The primary responsibility is to build Windows desktop interfaces with WPF, XAML, and MVVM. C# is also required.
cases.rationale: The benchmark profile lists C# but not the role-defining WPF, XAML, or MVVM desktop stack.

cases.description: Build and operate Kubernetes clusters on AWS using Terraform and Helm. Docker is required for container workflows. Application development is secondary.
cases.rationale: The role-defining platform stack is Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, and Helm; Docker alone does not prove that specialization.

cases.description: Develop Python services with FastAPI and PostgreSQL. Celery is required for background processing. Docker is a supporting tool.
cases.rationale: The benchmark profile does not list the role-defining Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, or Celery stack.

cases.description: Develop Java services with Spring Boot and Hibernate. Kafka and Maven are mandatory. SQL and Docker support the development workflow.
cases.rationale: SQL and Docker do not compensate for the missing role-defining Java and Spring ecosystem.

cases.description: Requirements: build APIs with C# and ASP.NET Core. Azure Functions is preferred. Possible technologies used across company projects include Azure SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Chrome DevTools, Fiddler, and several testing frameworks.
cases.rationale: Only C# and ASP.NET Core are required. Azure Functions is optional, while the long example list is context rather than mandatory competencies.

cases.description: C# and ASP.NET Core are required. Docker is useful. React experience is a nice-to-have.
cases.rationale: All required skills and Docker match, but the explicitly optional React skill is not listed.

cases.description: Join a collaborative engineering team. Our stack varies by project, and examples include Java, Python, C#, and JavaScript.
cases.rationale: The named technologies are examples, not reliable requirements, so the role cannot be scored confidently.

cases.description: Modernize backend services using Microsoft .NET Framework 4.7 or 4.8, Microsoft SQL Server, and Redis. These technologies define the primary application stack.
cases.rationale: Generic .NET and SQL in the benchmark profile do not prove .NET Framework 4.7/4.8 or SQL Server, and Redis is also absent.

cases.description: JavaScript and PostgreSQL are required to build the product. Java and generic SQL knowledge are not substitutes for those technologies.
cases.rationale: JavaScript matches, but generic SQL does not prove PostgreSQL and Java must not match JavaScript.
